PeakAir HVAC Services
Employee Summary & Key Employment Agreements — Confidential
WORKFORCE SUMMARY
As of March 1, 2025, PeakAir HVAC Services employs 8 individuals in the following roles:
⚠  Owner Dependence (Critical): Robert Kowalski personally manages ALL commercial account relationships and performs all job estimates over $5,000. No formal CRM system in use — customer relationships exist in owner's phone and memory. Transition plan has not been documented.
⚠  Key-Person Risk: Sandra Lim (Office Manager, 11 yrs) manages invoicing and scheduling systems. She has indicated informally she may retire within 2–3 years.
⚠  Retention Risk: Marcus Webb has received a verbal offer from Apex Comfort Systems (competitor). No non-compete agreement is in place for field technicians.
EMPLOYMENT TERMS & POLICIES
SAMPLE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT — FIELD TECHNICIAN
The following is representative of the standard employment agreement used for all field technicians. Actual signed copies are available in the due diligence data room.
THIS EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT is entered into as of the applicable hire date between PeakAir HVAC Services ('Company') and the employee named in the accompanying offer letter ('Employee').
1. POSITION & DUTIES. Employee is employed as a Field HVAC Technician and will perform installation, service, repair, and maintenance of HVAC systems as assigned.
2. COMPENSATION. Employee shall receive the hourly or annual salary stated in the offer letter. Compensation is reviewed annually at the Company's discretion.
3. BENEFITS. Employee is eligible for health insurance, Simple IRA participation, and PTO as described in the Employee Handbook.
4. AT-WILL EMPLOYMENT. Employment is at-will and may be terminated by either party at any time, with or without cause or notice.
5. CONFIDENTIALITY. Employee agrees not to disclose customer lists, pricing, or trade information during or after employment. No post-employment non-compete restriction applies to field technicians.
6. TOOLS & EQUIPMENT. Company-owned tools, vehicles, and equipment must be returned upon termination. Personal use of company vehicles is prohibited without written approval.
7. GOVERNING LAW. This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Iowa.
⚠  No non-compete clause is present for field technicians. Technicians who leave could immediately work for or start competing HVAC businesses. Buyer should negotiate employment agreements with key staff as a condition of closing.

COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT
1482 Commerce Pkwy, Suite 4, Cedar Falls, IA 50613
LEASE SUMMARY
⚠ BUYER ALERT: Landlord and Tenant are related parties (same owner). Lease expires December 31, 2025 — approximately 12 months post-projected closing. Buyer must independently negotiate a new lease. Market comparable rents in this submarket are estimated at $4,200–$4,800/month for similar space.
1. PREMISES
Landlord leases to Tenant the commercial premises described above, including exclusive use of the warehouse/storage bay and two designated parking spaces for service vehicles, plus access to shared loading dock.
2. TERM
The Lease term commences January 1, 2020 and expires December 31, 2025. Tenant has one option to renew for two (2) additional years, exercisable no later than ninety (90) days before expiration, subject to Landlord's written consent. There is no automatic holdover provision; month-to-month tenancy requires a 60-day notice from either party.
3. RENT
Tenant shall pay Base Rent of Three Thousand Dollars ($3,000) per month, due on the 1st of each month. Rent is inclusive of common area maintenance (CAM). No annual escalation clause is included in this lease. Note: Rent was set in 2020 and has not been adjusted to reflect market conditions.
4. UTILITIES
Tenant is responsible for electricity, gas, telephone, and internet. Landlord provides water and sewer. Tenant's average monthly utility spend is approximately $1,100.
5. MAINTENANCE & REPAIRS
Tenant is responsible for interior maintenance. Landlord is responsible for roof, exterior walls, and parking lot. HVAC maintenance for the premises is Tenant's responsibility. Any structural repairs exceeding $2,000 require Landlord written approval.
6. ASSIGNMENT & SUBLETTING
Tenant may not assign this Lease or sublet any portion without prior written consent of Landlord. In the event of a sale of Tenant's business, Landlord's consent to assignment shall not be unreasonably withheld, conditioned, or delayed, provided the assignee demonstrates financial capability acceptable to Landlord.
7. PERMITTED USE
Premises shall be used solely for HVAC contracting office operations, parts inventory, service vehicle staging, and related purposes. No retail sales to walk-in public. No hazardous materials storage beyond standard refrigerant quantities permitted by applicable EPA regulations.
8. INSURANCE
Tenant shall maintain general commercial liability insurance of no less than $1,000,000 per occurrence and $2,000,000 aggregate. Tenant shall provide Landlord with certificate of insurance naming Landlord as additional insured.
9. DEFAULT
If Tenant fails to pay rent within 5 days of due date, a 5% late fee applies. Default on rent for 10 days grants Landlord right to terminate. Tenant shall have 30 days to cure non-monetary defaults after written notice.
10. NOTICES
All notices shall be sent by certified mail or overnight courier to the addresses stated in the Lease Summary above.
